name: University of Cambridge
typicalOffer: A*A*A, Mathematics and Physics; Further Mathematics to AS or A level if your school offers it
notes: Cambridge students apply to Engineering (H100) and specialise in aerothermal and aerospace engineering from Year 3. ENGAA required; interview at college. Cambridge's aerospace group includes the Whittle Laboratory, world-leading in gas turbine aerodynamics. Mathematics and Physics required.

name: Imperial College London
typicalOffer: A*A*A*, A* in Mathematics; A/A* in Physics (A* if applying with three A-levels); A in a third and/or fourth subject
notes: Imperial Aeronautics is one of the world's top aerospace engineering departments. World-class in aerodynamics, structures and propulsion. Major recruiters include Rolls-Royce, BAE Systems, Airbus and MBDA. A* in Maths expected; Physics required.

name: University of Bristol
typicalOffer: A*AA, including A*A (any order) in Mathematics and one of Further Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Computer Science
notes: Bristol is arguably the UK's premier aerospace engineering university outside Oxbridge-Imperial. Airbus UK's main UK engineering centre is in Filton (3 miles from campus), providing exceptional placement and career opportunities. Strong aerodynamics, composites and avionics research. Mathematics and Physics required.

name: University of Southampton
typicalOffer: A*AA, including mathematics (minimum grade A) and physics (minimum grade A), with a pass in the physics practical
notes: Southampton's aerospace programme is distinguished by its astronautics component and world-leading aerodynamics research. The university operates its own supersonic wind tunnels. Strong satellite engineering and UAV research groups. Mathematics and Physics required.

name: University of Bath
typicalOffer: A*A*A, including A* in Mathematics and A in Physics
notes: Bath Aerospace Engineering consistently achieves excellent placement and graduate employment outcomes. Placement (Semester 5) with employers including Airbus, Rolls-Royce, BAE Systems and Leonardo. Mathematics and Physics required.

name: University of Manchester
typicalOffer: A*AA, including Mathematics, Physics, and one other subject (applicants without Physics may be considered if they studied Further Mathematics, case by case)
notes: Manchester Aerospace benefits from the National Aerospace Technology Exploitation Programme (NATEP) and close industry links. Strong in computational fluid dynamics and composites research. Mathematics and Physics required.

name: Loughborough University
notes: Loughborough Aeronautical Engineering is one of the UK's highest rated. Exceptional placement culture with aerospace firms. The aeronautics department operates the Loughborough University Wind Tunnel Facility. Mathematics and Physics required.

name: University of Sheffield
typicalOffer: A*AA, including Maths and a science (science subjects include Biology/Human Biology, Chemistry, Further Maths, Physics or Statistics)
notes: Sheffield's AMRC (Advanced Manufacturing Research Centre) with Boeing is a world-class aerospace manufacturing research facility. Strong composites, metallic structures and manufacturing engineering links. Mathematics and Physics required.

name: Queen's University Belfast
typicalOffer: ABB, including Mathematics and at least one from Physics (preferred), Biology, Chemistry, Technology and Design, Further Mathematics or Double Award Science
notes: Queen's Belfast has a well-regarded aerospace engineering school. Belfast's aerospace cluster includes Bombardier/Spirit AeroSystems — one of the world's largest aircraft component manufacturers — providing exceptional local industry links. Mathematics and Physics required.

name: University of Glasgow
typicalOffer: AAA, A-level Mathematics at A, plus A-level Physics or Design & Technology (3D or Product Design only) at A
notes: Glasgow Aerospace Engineering has strong aerodynamics, flight mechanics and propulsion research. Scottish 4-year BEng or 5-year MEng. Industry links with BAE Systems (Warton, Lancashire) and Leonardo (Edinburgh). Mathematics and Physics required.
